description: 37 CFR 201.40(b)(19): the exempted classes, (i)(A) restore personal local gameplay after server access ceased, (i)(B) preservation by an eligible library, archives or museum after server access ceased, (ii) preservation of games no longer reasonably available, (iii) console programs needed for that preservation; and the (b)(19)(iv) defined terms.
title: Exemption for video game preservation, 37 CFR 201.40(b)(19)
